=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- CLAUDE.md:lines 1966-1978 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "merged" report form (`PR #<n> merged — <no action needed | action needed>`) does not have the issue-prefix annotation that the "closed" form (`PR #<n> closed — decision needed` (with `#<issue> · ` in front when the PR has a source issue)) does. The Session titles rule says every session title carries the issue prefix when a source issue exists. Both forms are produced by the same `set_session_title` rename in §26.D and should follow the same convention; the diff updates only one form.
  WHY: The renaming instruction in §26.D would be ambiguous about whether the merged report session carries the issue prefix; an operator implementing the rule has to choose between (a) follow the Session titles rule and add the prefix, or (b) follow the literal text and omit it. CLAUDE.md §7 (operational clarity) is meant to be free of such ambiguity.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
